survey: A stage spotlight hangs under a flat two-chord ladder truss. The truss has a top chord and a bottom chord joined by diagonal lacing bars, all meeting at real nodes. A clamp block grips the top chord, and a short vertical stem runs from it down in front of the bottom chord to the top of a U-shaped yoke. The yoke's two arms come down on either side of the cylindrical lamp body. On the right side the arm ends at a round pivot with a yellow tilt-lock knob. On the left side the pivot is hidden behind the body, which fits the viewing angle. The lamp body has cooling slots on top and a yellow trim band, and its front faces down-left toward the camera. The front holds three round LED lenses (yellow, cyan and red) inside a bezel. The coloured light beams come from the lenses, which is expected for a working light. There is no power cable, which counts as a simplification, not an error.
